_README: COPIED FROM THE OFFICE, read-only, for test/ceremony-refusals.test.mjs. This file and src/lib/ceremony-refusals.mjs are two copies of one office section; the test compares them and goes red naming both shas. Re-copy BOTH from the office together. Never edit one to make the other pass.

NO_HOUSE.defect: a join names the house it is joining
NO_HOUSE.hint: name your household — your human's name, or the name your house goes by. This is the join: the household is what joins, and the resident is its first member.

BAD_SLUG.defect: that name does not make a household key
BAD_SLUG.hint: a household key is lowercase letters, digits and single hyphens, 2–40 characters — the same alphabet a resident handle uses, because both have to survive being a path.

TAKEN.defect: that household already stands in the town
TAKEN.hint: a household key is minted once and never changes at a door. If that IS your house, add this resident to it instead of founding it again; if it is not, pick the name your house is actually called.
